meta.purpose: Deck-profile defaults for lands whose real output cannot be read off the card. Layered on top of premodern_lands.json by the calculator; never merged into it.
meta.scope_rule: Any card in premodern_lands.json with a non-null fetches object, any ability with a non-null variable_amount, or any ability whose produces.mode is 'derived'.
meta.warning: Every number here is a judgement call about typical decks and should be argued with. premodern_lands.json contains only what the card and the rulings say; this file contains what we think it is worth. If the two ever disagree, the data file is right and this one is wrong.

entries.name: Icatian Store
entries.basis: Charging costs a turn each, so treat as one mana per turn invested rather than a source you can tap on demand.

entries.name: Thawing Glaciers
entries.basis: Produces no mana itself and costs one per activation. Its value is land count over a long game, not mana on any given turn, and it consumes your land drop every turn it is replayed.

entries.name: Bad River
entries.assumed_colors: colors of the Island and Swamp cards in the decklist
entries.basis: Counts as a source of whatever it can actually find in this deck. Zero for a color with no fetchable land.

entries.name: Reflecting Pool
entries.assumed_colors: union of the colors of the other lands in the decklist
entries.basis: One mana, and color identity borrowed from the rest of the mana base. Produces nothing if it is the only mana-producing land you control.

entries.name: Gaea's Cradle
entries.basis: Typical creature count on the turns a deck that plays it wants to untap with it. Zero in the opening turns and in any draw where the board has been swept.

entries.name: Serra's Sanctum
entries.basis: Typical enchantment count once an Enchantress-style deck is running. Zero before the first enchantment resolves.

entries.name: Fountain of Cho
entries.basis: One mana per turn invested. Easier to use than the Fallen Empires cycle because it untaps normally.

entries.name: Terrain Generator
entries.basis: Count only its own colorless mana. The basic it deploys should be counted as that basic, not as extra output from this card.

entries.name: Meteor Crater
entries.assumed_colors: colors of your own non-land permanents once a board exists
entries.basis: Zero with only lands on the battlefield, since lands are colorless. Cannot cast your first spell, only later ones in a color you already have out.

entries.name: Terminal Moraine
entries.basis: Count only its own colorless mana. The basic it fetches should be counted as that basic, not as extra output from this card.

entries.name: Cabal Coffers
entries.basis: Typical Swamp count when a deck that plays it wants to activate. Costs {2} to use, so it is net positive only past two Swamps and produces nothing on its own.

entries.name: Krosan Verge
entries.basis: Counts as a source of both, delayed. Both lands arrive tapped and the activation costs {2} plus the land itself.

entries.name: Bloodstained Mire
entries.assumed_colors: colors of the Swamp and Mountain cards in the decklist
entries.basis: Counts as a source of whatever it can actually find in this deck. Zero for a color with no fetchable land. Costs 1 life and can be cracked the turn it is played.
